structured_output.title: DNS caching optimization applies to cert-manager installation
structured_output.content: This environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 and uses cert-manager certificates (CRD certificates.cert-manager.io [v1]), which depend on DNS zone discovery during challenge validation. The v1.18.0 feature optimizes the `FindZoneByFqdn` function by caching DNS responses and handling TTL expiration. This optimization affects the DNS challenge handling that your environment relies on. Inspect your certificate issuance logs and DNS challenge configuration after upgrade to verify the caching behavior does not introduce unexpected DNS resolution delays or cache staleness issues.
